subject: served-operator-request-read-consistency
source_of_truth: repository/workspace-scoped request, dependant, work-item and append-only request-event rows
initial_state: one open request with one active dependant and its attached work revision
caller connection may already own an implicit transaction

operations.name: get-or-list-request
operations.synchronization: read request header, commit independent writer, then read dependants and current work

operations.name: withdraw-last-dependant
operations.synchronization: independent connection commits after the reader obtains its request header

operations.name: change-work-status
operations.synchronization: independent owner CAS commits before the reader fetches current work

operations.name: read-or-reject-request-page
operations.synchronization: get, list and events use a sibling while the caller retains its transaction ID

consistency.object: one request aggregate or event-page response

assumptions.isolation: sibling PostgreSQL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY; writer uses an independent connection
assumptions.clock: freshness uses owner clock within the response; no timing-dependent race oracle
assumptions.fairness: one independent writer completes synchronously in the reader boundary hook

invariants: request header and dependants exclude a withdrawal committed after snapshot establishment
current-work revision and source-changed flag exclude later work commits
a later read observes the committed writer state
each sibling is read-only and closes on success or rejection
faults: work status change between constituent reads
oracles: first response revision1/open/active followed by revision2/withdrawn/withdrawn
first response retains attached work revision followed by source-changed on the next read
server isolation and read-only settings, sibling closure and unchanged caller transaction ID
